Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

ggzoomer 1.0.0

  • The package is renamed from fmggp2 to ggzoomer. It no longer supports the book: co_box(), status(), %nin%, theme_fmggp2(), the Ubuntu font functions, and the bundled Ubuntu fonts move to the new fmutils package, and the 90s themes live in ggrewindr.
  • Breaking: all 48 late 90s themes are removed, along with their images, tests, the bundled Press Start 2P font, and gameboy_font(). The book chapters that call them need updating.
  • 37 new themes named after Gen Z aesthetics, trends, and objects: theme_airfryer(), theme_asmr(), theme_axolotl(), theme_boba(), theme_capybara(), theme_cleangirl(), theme_coastal(), theme_coquette(), theme_cottagecore(), theme_darkacademia(), theme_digicam(), theme_doomscroll(), theme_egirl(), theme_fidget(), theme_frog(), theme_frutigeraero(), theme_goblincore(), theme_gorpcore(), theme_groupchat(), theme_indiesleaze(), theme_kidcore(), theme_ledstrip(), theme_liminal(), theme_livestream(), theme_matcha(), theme_mermaidcore(), theme_photodump(), theme_plushie(), theme_slime(), theme_thrift(), theme_tumbler(), theme_unboxing(), theme_vaporwave(), theme_vinyl(), theme_voicenote(), theme_weirdcore(), and theme_wiredbuds().
  • Each palette follows how the topic looks to Gen Z online (for example, theme_cleangirl() uses gold jewelry, an iced matcha latte, fluffy brows, dewy skin, and neutral clothing). Each theme links its Wikipedia article and shows a freely licensed image from it. theme_capybara() follows the “After Party” single cover that capybara memes pair with, not the animal, theme_airfryer() follows the Crispi air fryer colors, and theme_asmr() follows the indigo, fairy light set behind Gibi ASMR’s videos. Palettes are then adjusted for contrast: text at least 4.5:1, titles at least 4.5:1, marks at least 1.5:1 against the panel, and marks at least 6 CIEDE2000 apart under normal vision, deuteranopia, and protanopia.
  • Themes with a dark default have mode = "light": theme_asmr(), theme_darkacademia(), theme_digicam(), theme_doomscroll(), theme_egirl(), theme_goblincore(), theme_indiesleaze(), theme_ledstrip(), and theme_livestream().
  • Each theme’s help page and vignette section explains why the topic is included and why it matters to Gen Z.
  • The themes vignette shows every theme with its image, credit, and simulated data.

Developed by Martin Frigaard.
